    The Natural Wood Akupanel is a slatted wall panel that reduces echo and adds warmth to any room. Real wood veneer on every slat — handpicked, so no two panels look alike. Works on walls and ceilings, pairs with Create accessories. Rooted in Scandinavian design principles — natural materials and calm environments working together.

    Materials & care

    • Materials:
      Slats: MDF.
      Surface: Real wood veneer (handpicked).
      Acoustic felt: 50% recycled plastic (PET).

      Surface:
      Real wood veneer — natural variation in grain and color. No two panels are identical. Slats have slightly rounded edges for a more natural finish.

    • Cleaning:
      Clean with a dust brush or vacuum cleaner. Use a tightly wrung-out cloth for spot cleaning.

      Care note:
      Real wood veneer can develop a natural patina over time with light exposure. This is expected and part of the natural material character.

    Installation & safety

    • 1. Ensure your wall surface is clean, dry, and flat before installation.

      2. Hold the panel against the wall and mark the screw positions through the felt backing.

      3. Drill pilot holes at the marked positions and insert wall plugs if required.

      4. Fasten the panel to the wall with 15 screws per panel, driven through the felt backing.

      5. Alternatively, apply mounting glue evenly to the felt backing, press the panel firmly against the wall, and hold for 20–30 seconds.

      6. Use a spirit level throughout to ensure the panel hangs straight.

      • Installation guide Akupanel | Installation on wall with screws
      • Installation guide Akupanel | Installation on wall with glue
      • Installation guide Akupanel | Installation on formwork
      • Installation guide Akupanel | Installation on ceiling

      Maximum load: 40 kg per 60×60 cm (vertically mounted) / 5 kg per 60×60 cm (horizontally mounted).

      Allow glue to cure fully before hanging accessories.

    • 6-9 working days

    Everyday spaces, elevated

    What Akupanels do for your room

    Sound improvement
    Akupanel reduce echo and improve room acoustics by absorbing sound waves. With the right setup, they can achieve Sound Absorption Class A, creating a calmer and more comfortable space.

    Made to evolve
    Pair your panels with create accessories to add shelves, hooks, and storage — easy to mount, easy to move, and simple to update as your needs change.

    Designed to fit your space
    Available in multiple sizes and finishes, Akupanel adapt to both small and large rooms — walls, ceilings, and everything in between.

    Easy to install
    Designed for simple installation. With clear video guides and a straightforward setup, most rooms can be transformed in just a few hours — no special tools required.
